description.value: DQ Grill & Chill is a full-service Dairy Queen location on Hillside Avenue in Victoria, offering burgers, chicken, and ice cream alongside the classic soft-serve treats the brand is known for. As a sit-down fast-food restaurant rather than a kiosk, it provides a reliable stop for a hot meal or cold treat mid-ride. It sits in a busy commercial corridor making it easy to find on a cycling route through the city.
